properties.name: Red Hook, Brooklyn
properties.note: Approximate peninsula boundary. North edge follows Hamilton Ave / Gowanus Expressway; east edge hugs the west bank of the Gowanus Canal / Gowanus Bay; west and south edges run into Buttermilk Channel / Upper Bay (open water, excluded once masked to land elev>0).
